body: Paramjit Singh Soni (Promoter, Executive Director & Vice-Chairman) on the Q1FY25 call (2024-08-09), prompted: "I expect maybe quarter 2 to be sequentially flat" Metric: Q2FY25 revenue QoQ. body: Vimal Kejriwal (MD & CEO) on 2025-02-04 (Q3FY25 concall transcript): "in the next maybe a quarter or two, maximum, we should be able to physically complete all the legacy orders" Metric: Legacy railway project completion. Target: all physically complete. Deadline: 2025-09-30. Specificity: range; prompted by analyst. Status as of 2026-11-21: missed. Evidence: Jan-26: 'closed at least 10% of our railway projects ... another 20% will close in this quarter'; Aug-26: slow projects 'at 95-97% closure'; Nov-26: 'by March, we'll just have two or three projects to be closed'. More than 1 quarter late. Explanation given: clients reversing agreed de-scoping, block availability, depot design approvals (prompted)
